hooks.prompt:
Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

First, read tool_input.command. If it does not invoke `gh pr create`, respond {"ok": true} immediately and do nothing else.

Otherwise a PR to master is about to be opened. If the code-review skill (/code-review) has NOT already been run against the latest changes in this conversation, respond {"ok": false, "reason": "Run /code-review, address its findings, then retry opening the PR."}. Otherwise respond {"ok": true}.
